title: Design System: Eljo Shurdhi — The Drawing Set

display.purpose: The page's one headline (h1); never above 6rem.

price.purpose: Prices as the key dimension on a sheet; lining tabular figures.

stamp.purpose: Rubber-stamp lettering for states (Recommended, Ready to build).

lead.purpose: The paragraph under a headline, in graphite, max 36em.

body.purpose: Running text; 65ch measure where it runs long.

label.purpose: Mono label: header sheet numbers, package marks, case-study tag lines.

annotation.purpose: Mono annotation: title-block field labels, schedule headers, view-title notes, nav sheet numbers.

shadows.name: figure
shadows.purpose: Only under the alpha-matted portrait cut-out standing on its ground line.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: All UI responses: press, hover nudges, header hide, fills building in.

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: The phone sheet index dropping in (380ms in, 260ms out on ease-out).

motion.name: plot
motion.purpose: Signature: drawings plot themselves when scrolled into view.

motion.name: build
motion.purpose: Signature: fills wipe in after the linework.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: drawings render finished; the sheet index fades (200ms)

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action per view: safety orange, ink lettering, squared corners.
components.html: Start My Project
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-radius: 2px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 200ms ease, color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn svg { transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action, #f05a1a); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--action, #f05a1a); color: var(--action-ink, #0e1f2e); } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--action-hover, #d94b0d); } .ds-btn:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The alternative action: an ink outline that fills with ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn2 { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-radius: 2px; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #0e1f2e); color: var(--ink, #0e1f2e); background: transparent; font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 200ms ease, color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn2:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn2:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action, #f05a1a); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-btn2:hover { background: var(--ink, #0e1f2e); color: var(--paper, #f1f4f6); } }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A labelled field with a 3:1 boundary; 16px text so phones never zoom.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; max-width: 22rem; font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #0e1f2e); } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--field-border, rgb(14 31 46 / 0.5)); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--paper, #f1f4f6); color: inherit; font: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.4; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-2, #3e5468); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--ink-2, #3e5468); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--line, #2457a5); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action, #f05a1a); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Choice Chips
components.description: Radio choices drawn as chips; the selected one fills with diazo blue.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip { position: relative; } .ds-chip input { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--field-border, rgb(14 31 46 / 0.5)); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--paper, #f1f4f6); color: var(--ink, #0e1f2e); font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-chip input:checked + span { border-color: var(--line, #2457a5); background: var(--line, #2457a5); color: var(--paper, #f1f4f6); } .ds-chip input:active + span { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-chip input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2px solid var(--action, #f05a1a); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-chip input:not(:checked):hover + span { border-color: var(--ink-2, #3e5468); } }

narrative.overview:
The site is the construction drawing set for the visitor's next website: planned, priced in writing and approved before anything is built. Every page is a sheet with a number (A-001 Cover sheet, A-101 As-built drawings, A-201 Package schedule, A-301 The builder, A-401 Request for quote). The component language comes from the drawing set itself: title blocks, callout bubbles, view titles, revision clouds and deltas, schedules, general notes and rubber stamps. The hero is the proposed homepage drawn as linework that plots itself and then builds in.

There are two prints of one drawing. The whiteprint is cool drafting paper with ink and diazo-blue linework on a faint drafting grid. The blueprint is a Prussian-blue ground with white linework. Layout, type and content are identical in both; only the tokens swap. Safety orange is the one loud colour and it marks action. The density is that of a well-kept sheet: generous margins, hairline structure, and nothing floating.

The world refuses the freelancer default: a dark page, one neon accent, glow orbs and a grid of equal cards.
keyCharacteristics: Two prints (whiteprint / blueprint) driven by one token set; the reader toggles them like prints of the same drawing.
Safety orange reserved for action, stamps and revision marks.
Condensed drafting lettering for display; mono only for annotation.
Structure from hairline rules and 1.5px linework, 2px corners, no shadows on containers.
One authored motion: plot, then build.

rules.name: The Safety Orange Rule
rules.body: Orange means "act here" or "this was marked". It is never a background tint, a divider or decoration. The only orange field on a page is the final call to action.

rules.name: The Two Prints Rule
rules.body: Every surface ships in both prints from the same markup. A colour is chosen by token (`--paper`, `--ink`, `--line`, `--action`), never hard-coded per theme.

rules.name: The Annotation Rule
rules.body: Overpass Mono is reserved for annotation: dimensions, figures, sheet numbers, title-block field labels, schedule headers, scale notes and package marks. Headings, body, buttons and stamps never use mono.

rules.name: The Lettering Rule
rules.body: Anything lettered for display (headings, view titles, stamps, prices) is set in Barlow Condensed. Tracking never goes tighter than -0.012em on display sizes.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Containers are defined by rules and linework, never by a shadow and never by a border-plus-shadow. A frame is a 1.5px diazo line; a divider is a 1px rule.

dos: **Do** take every colour from the token pair so both prints stay correct (`--paper`, `--ink`, `--ink-2`, `--line`, `--action`, `--action-text`).
**Do** letter display text, stamps and prices in Barlow Condensed, and keep Overpass Mono for annotation (dimensions, figures, sheet numbers, field labels).
**Do** frame grouped facts as a title block, list sequences as numbered callouts, and present comparisons as a schedule.
**Do** keep UI motion under 300ms on ease-out (`cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)`), animate only transform, opacity and clip-path, and gate hover effects behind `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`.
**Do** use stamp orange (#c2410c) for any orange lettering smaller than 24px on whiteprint.
donts: **Don't** use a dark page with one neon accent, glow orbs, or a grid of equal floating cards.
**Don't** put a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading; marks and numbers sit on the heading's line or in their own column.
**Don't** add shadows to containers, or pair a border with a shadow; the portrait cut-out is the only shadow.
**Don't** use orange as decoration, as a tint, or for body text.
**Don't** draw sketch-style illustrations; drawings are crisp geometric linework.
**Don't** set headings, buttons or stamps in mono.
